metadata.question: Did clouds cover a larger area within a 10 km radius of Halema‘uma‘u Crater, the summit caldera of Hawaii’s Kīlauea volcano, than the volcanic plume on July 20, 2025 at 10:44 am local time?

data.raw_code: The question is: "Did clouds cover a larger area within a 10 km radius of Halema'uma'u Crater, the summit caldera of Hawaii's Kīlauea volcano, than the volcanic plume on July 20, 2025 at 10:44 am local time?" Interpretation: - We need to compare cloud area vs. volcanic plume area within 10 km radius of the crater. - Date: July 20, 2025 at 10:44 am local time (Hawaii time = UTC-10:00). - Need to find satellite imagery at that exact time. - Both clouds and volcanic plumes are visible in satellite imagery. Key considerations: 1. Time conversion: 10:44 am Hawaii time = 20:44 UTC on July 20, 2025. 2. We need high temporal resolution imagery. GOES-16/17 geostationary satellites provide imagery every 10-15 minutes. 3. For cloud detection: Use visible/IR bands. For volcanic plume detection: Use SO₂ bands (UV) or thermal anomalies. 4. Best collection: GOES-16 ABI L1b Radiances (NOAA/GOES/16/MCMIPF) has 1-minute data with visible and IR bands. 5. Location: Halema'uma'u Crater at 19.4062°N, 155.2833°W. 6. We need to calculate: - Cloud area: using reflectance threshold in visible band (e.g., CMI_C02 > 0.3) - Volcanic plume area: using SO₂ detection or thermal anomaly (CMI_C13 band for IR brightness temperature > background) Strategy: 1. Get GOES-16 image at 2025-07-20T20:44:00Z ± 5 minutes. 2. Define 10 km buffer around crater. 3. Create cloud mask: CMI_C02 reflectance > 0.3 (or use cloud mask product if available). 4. Create volcanic plume mask: - Option 1: SO₂ index using CMI_C08-CMI_C10 difference - Option 2: Thermal anomaly (CMI_C13 brightness temperature > local mean + threshold) 5. Count pixels for each mask. 6. Compare areas. Data quality checks: - Check if image exists (C1 if no data). - Check valid pixel counts (C2 if 0 pixels). - Validate results (C3 if NaN/invalid). Output: - Print image count, cloud pixel count, plume pixel count. - Final answer: A (Yes - clouds larger), B (No - plume larger or equal), or C1-C3. Note: The date is in the future (2025). We need to handle potential missing data. Fallback: If GOES-16 has no data, try GOES-17 or widen time window. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const crater = ee.Geometry.Point([-155.2833, 19.4062]); // Halema'uma'u Crater const radius = 10000; // 10 km in meters const roi = crater.buffer(radius); // Convert local time to UTC: 10:44 am Hawaii time (UTC-10) = 20:44 UTC const targetDate = '2025-07-20'; const targetTime = '20:44:00'; const startTime = ee.Date(targetDate + 'T' + targetTime + 'Z'); const endTime = startTime.advance(10, 'minute'); // 10-minute window // 2. Data Acquisition - GOES-16 Advanced Baseline Imager (ABI) Level 1b // Collection: NOAA/GOES/16/MCMIPF (1-minute multi-channel) const goesCollection = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/GOES/16/MCMIPF') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(startTime, endTime); const collectionSize = goesCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`GOES-16 images in time window: ${collectionSize}`); // Check C1: No images if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("No GOES-16 images found. Trying GOES-17..."); // Fallback to GOES-17 const goes17Collection = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/GOES/17/MCMIPF') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(startTime, endTime); const goes17Size = goes17Collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`GOES-17 images in time window: ${goes17Size}`); if (goes17Size === 0) { console.log("No data for target time."); console.log("C1"); return; } var image = goes17Collection.first(); var satellite = "GOES-17"; } else { var image = goesCollection.first(); var satellite = "GOES-16"; } console.log(`Using ${satellite} image at: ${image.date().format().getInfo()}`); // 3. Cloud Detection (Band C02: Red visible, 0.64 µm) // Reflectance threshold > 0.3 indicates likely clouds const visibleBand = 'CMI_C02'; // 0.64 µm visible band const cloudMask = image.select(visibleBand).gt(0.3); // 4. Volcanic Plume Detection // Method 1: SO₂ detection using difference of bands C08 (6.19 µm) and C10 (7.34 µm) // SO₂ absorbs at 7.34 µm, so higher difference indicates SO₂ plume const bandC08 = 'CMI_C08'; // 6.19 µm const bandC10 = 'CMI_C10'; // 7.34 µm const so2Index = image.select(bandC08).subtract(image.select(bandC10)); // Threshold: SO₂ index > 2.0 K (based on typical SO₂ detection) const plumeMask = so2Index.gt(2.0); // Alternative: Thermal anomaly (Band C13: 10.3 µm) for hot plume // const thermalBand = 'CMI_C13'; // const backgroundTemp = image.select(thermalBand).reduceRegion({ // reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), // geometry: roi, // scale: 2000, // maxPixels: 1e9 // }).get(thermalBand); // const plumeMaskThermal = image.select(thermalBand).gt(ee.Number(backgroundTemp).add(5)); // 5. Count pixels for each mask const cloudCount = cloudMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: roi, scale: 1000, // GOES-16 visible band nominal resolution at nadir ~0.5-1 km maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('constant'); const plumeCount = plumeMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: roi, scale: 2000, // IR bands have ~2 km resolution maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('constant'); const cloudPixels = cloudCount.getInfo(); const plumePixels = plumeCount.getInfo(); console.log(`Cloud pixels: ${cloudPixels}`); console.log(`Plume pixels: ${plumePixels}`); // Check C2: No valid pixels if (cloudPixels === 0 && plumePixels === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels for either clouds or plume."); console.log("C2"); return; } // Check C3: Invalid results if (cloudPixels === null || plumePixels === null || isNaN(cloudPixels) || isNaN(plumePixels)) { console.log("Calculation failed (null/NaN)."); console.log("C3"); return; } // 6. Compare areas // Note: Pixels counts are at different scales (1km vs 2km). // Convert to approximate area: pixel count * pixel area const cloudArea = cloudPixels * 1000 * 1000; // 1km² per pixel const plumeArea = plumePixels * 2000 * 2000; // 4km² per pixel console.log(`Cloud area (m²): ${cloudArea.toFixed(0)}`); console.log(`Plume area (m²): ${plumeArea.toFixed(0)}`); // Final comparison if (cloudArea > plumeArea) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
